newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RTRS-NZ Jun qtr s/adj retail sales rise 1.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NZ Jun qtr s/adj retail sales rise 1.6 pct.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) on Friday released the following retail sales data for June and the June 1997 quarter.
Revised figures are in brackets.
Seasonally adjusted sales, pct change from previous qtr:
June qtr 1997 March qtr 1997 June qtr 1996
S/adj sales at Mar 1995 qtr prices, pct chg from prev qtr:
June qtr 1997 Mar qtr 1997 June qtr 1996
Actual sales, pct change from same qtr previous year:
June qtr 1997 March qtr 1997 June qtr 1996
+0.2 pct -2.0 pct +4.1 pct
Seasonally-adjusted sales, pct change from previous month:
June 1997 May 1997 June 1996
Total actual retail sales (pct change from same month previous year):
June 1997 May 1997 June 1996
NOTE - Economists polled by Reuters had forecast on average a 1.28 percent rise in seasonally adjusted sales from the March to the June quarters, and a fall of 0.17 percent in the June month.
